question: Shri Narayana Guru, who belonged to the Ezhava caste, started his social reform movement in the modern state of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Shri Narayana Guru was a prominent social reformer from the Ezhava caste in Kerala.

• He was known for his efforts to reform the caste system and promote social equality in the early 20th century.

• He established the Sree Narayana Dharma Paripalana (SNDP) Yogam in 1903 to promote the welfare of the Ezhava community.

• His famous teachings include "One caste, one religion, one god for all," emphasizing the unity and equality of all human beings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Narayana Guru's Early Life**

• Shri Narayana Guru was born in 1856 in Chempazhanthy, a village near Thiruvananthapuram in Kerala.

• He belonged to the Ezhava community, which was considered a lower caste in the traditional Hindu caste hierarchy.

• His early life was marked by a deep sense of spirituality and a desire to attain knowledge.

• **Social Reform and Teachings**

• Narayana Guru's social reform movement focused on the upliftment of the Ezhava community and other oppressed castes.

• He emphasized the importance of education, self-respect, and economic independence for social progress.

• He opposed the caste-based discrimination and promoted the idea of universal brotherhood and equality.

• His teachings were simple yet profound, advocating for a life of virtue, compassion, and devotion to God.

• **Sree Narayana Dharma Paripalana (SNDP) Yogam**

• In 1903, Shri Narayana Guru founded the SNDP Yogam, an organization dedicated to the social and educational advancement of the Ezhava community.

• The SNDP Yogam played a crucial role in establishing schools, temples, and other institutions to promote the welfare of the community.

• It also worked towards the abolition of discriminatory practices and the promotion of social justice.

• **Legacy and Impact**

• Shri Narayana Guru's legacy continues to inspire people across Kerala and beyond.

• His teachings and social reforms have had a lasting impact on the fight against caste discrimination and the promotion of social equality.

• He is remembered and revered as a saint, philosopher, and social reformer who dedicated his life to the betterment of humanity.
